mission: Turn large volumes of published papers into clear, trustworthy prose: claims, evidence, contradictions, and readiness/trust summaries with citations.
north_star: Papers processed into structured claim/evidence records per day.
Share of claims grounded by cited evidence spans, not generic summaries.
Share of papers/claims with explicit support/counter/neutral stance labels.
Contradictions surfaced with enough context for a human to adjudicate.
Final prose paragraphs accepted as clear, cited, uncertainty-aware, and useful.
feature_gate: UI/runtime features wait unless they directly increase ingestion throughput, evidence quality, contradiction finding, trust/readiness scoring, or final prose synthesis.

lanes.name: Corpus intake and inventory
lanes.goal: Know what papers exist, which ones have metadata gaps, and which tranche should be processed first.
first_cards: Inventory current paper universe and counts without DB writes.
Rank candidate tranches by relevance, metadata completeness, and contradiction potential.
Produce a 25-paper pilot manifest with stable IDs and source URLs.
lanes.done_when: A manifest exists with paper_id/arxiv/doi/title/year/source_url plus reason-for-inclusion and known gaps.

lanes.name: Paper-to-claim extraction
lanes.owner: Lana reasoning lane, Hermes verifies schema
lanes.goal: Convert each paper into atomic claims and evidence snippets that can be checked later.
first_cards: Define the distillation JSONL contract: paper, claim, evidence_span, stance, uncertainty, limitations.
Run a small manual/guided extraction on 3 papers to calibrate claim granularity.
Record failure modes: vague claim, missing method, unsupported conclusion, duplicate claim.
lanes.done_when: Each pilot paper has 3-8 atomic claims with quoted/located evidence snippets and caveats.

lanes.name: Contradiction and trust/readiness
lanes.goal: Find where papers agree, disagree, or are too weak to support prose.
first_cards: Build a stance matrix over pilot claims: support / counter / mixed / insufficient.
Create contradiction cards with the exact papers and claim text involved.
Assign readiness labels: ready for prose, needs adjudication, needs more evidence, reject/low confidence.
lanes.done_when: Every synthesis candidate has a readiness label and a reason, with unresolved contradictions explicit.

lanes.name: Prose synthesis
lanes.goal: Turn structured evidence into readable, cited paragraphs without overstating certainty.
first_cards: Design paragraph templates: what is known, what is disputed, why it matters, readiness/caveat.
Draft 5 prose examples from the pilot tranche with citations to paper IDs and evidence snippets.
Review for overclaiming, missing caveats, and human readability.
lanes.done_when: At least 5 concise prose blocks are citation-backed, uncertainty-aware, and reviewable by a human.

lanes.name: Evaluation and human adjudication
lanes.owner: Hermes board, Goru metrics, human final judgment
lanes.goal: Measure whether the distillation is actually reliable and useful.
first_cards: Create a rubric: groundedness, contradiction handling, citation precision, clarity, uncertainty.
Score pilot outputs and list the top recurring defects.
Define stop/go thresholds before any DB publication or product surface work.
lanes.done_when: A pilot scorecard says what passed, what failed, and what must improve before scale-up.

lanes.name: Product/UI only as support
lanes.goal: Use UI only to expose corpus/prose progress or let humans review evidence faster.
first_cards: Keep current PR #72 paper surfaces as support tools.
Do not start new feature work unless it unblocks one of L1-L5.
lanes.done_when: Every feature request names the distillation bottleneck it removes and the metric it improves.

cadence.today: Assemble board and choose the first non-mutating pilot path.
cadence.48_hours: Inventory corpus and produce 25-paper pilot manifest plus extraction schema.
cadence.one_week: Produce 25-paper pilot artifacts: structured claims/evidence/contradictions and 5-10 prose drafts.
cadence.two_weeks: Score pilot, fix pipeline defects, then decide whether to scale to 100+ papers or build review UI.

approvals.label: Read-only board pilot
approvals.phrase: APPROVE PAPER DISTILLATION BOARD READ-ONLY PILOT: Run a read-only corpus/prose readiness pass that inventories current papers, claim/evidence coverage, contradiction gaps, and prose-output candidates; write only docs/JSONL/report artifacts under .hermes or docs; do not deploy/restart, write DB rows, run migrations, change production config, use OpenClaw relay, or commit/push/merge without separate approval.

approvals.label: Offline 25-paper pilot artifacts
approvals.phrase: APPROVE PAPER DISTILLATION PILOT ARTIFACTS: Build an offline 25-paper pilot packet with paper summaries, extracted claims, evidence snippets, contradiction notes, trust/readiness labels, and concise cited prose drafts as docs/JSONL/Markdown only. No DB writes, no migrations, no deploy/restart, no production config changes, no OpenClaw relay, no commit/push/merge without separate approval.

approvals.label: Overnight non-mutating paper-distillation run
approvals.phrase: APPROVE OVERNIGHT PAPER DISTILLATION RUN: Spend up to 8-12 hours on non-mutating paper-distillation work: corpus inventory, extraction schema, 25-paper pilot artifacts, contradiction/trust rubric, and cockpit checkpoints. Write docs/JSONL/Markdown only; no DB writes, migrations, deploy/restart, production config changes, OpenClaw relay, or branch/PR/merge unless separately approved.

safety: No DB writes without separate explicit approval.
No migrations without separate explicit approval.
No deploy/restart without separate explicit approval.
Feature/UI work remains gated by the paper-prose mission.
